title: Pipeline scheduler (rayon workers + HIP streams + async overlap)
description:
## Goal

Build the hybrid pipeline scheduler that pairs each rayon worker with
one HIP stream and overlaps CPU preparation of batch N+1 against GPU
execution of batch N. This is the foundational Phase C task; the DAG
executor (`de160fc5`), resume (`571c11c4`), and failure wiring
(`42eac5cc`) all build on it.

## Context

Task under story `9e853c62` (Hybrid CPU+GPU executor) within epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §1 (Stage `execution_class`),
§7 (multi-GPU seams). Wave C.1: depends on Stories A (`bcf7776d`) and
B (`1f588e2a`) being done.

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-10 (user-approved; scope-correct move after
code-review round 2 — no rigor lost).** Round-2 findings F2/F3
demanded that the scheduler execute EVERY pipeline stage via its
type-erased `AnyStage` object routed by `execution_class()`
(including the `Hybrid` split-per-batch arm) and emit per-stage
start/end spans. That per-stage-driven execution machinery is the
core deliverable of the DAG topology executor `de160fc5`
(`TopologyExecutor::run(pipeline, scheduler, batch)` — "dispatching
its stages in topologically correct order"); implementing it inside
this task would build the stage-walking executor twice in
consecutive tasks and displace the byte-identity-pinned SSOT CPU
path mid-task. Per the user's decision the obligations MOVED, with
`[hard]` rigor intact, to `de160fc5`: (a) per-stage execution via
`AnyStage` by `execution_class()` with the `Hybrid` arm exercised
via a synthetic Hybrid-class test stage; (b) per-stage start/end
spans carrying all six fields; (c) byte-identity of the stage-driven
path vs the SSOT path. THIS task's deliverable-3/4 are amended below
to the routing-decision and dispatch-unit-span contract it delivers,
plus the round-2 F1 fix (deterministic indexed stream ownership).

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/src/executor/scheduler.rs`:
   - `pub struct Scheduler { rayon_pool: ThreadPool, hip_pool:
     Option<HipStreamPool> }`.
   - Per-worker association: worker `i` owns stream `i % n_streams`,
     selected by DETERMINISTIC INDEX into the pool (round-2 F1: the
     racing round-robin `acquire()` is not worker-deterministic and
     can desynchronise the recorded `stream_id` from the actual
     stream).
   - `Scheduler::run(pipeline: &Pipeline, batch: BatchHandle) ->
     Result<SimulationResults, StageError>` driving the pipeline
     stages through workers with double-buffered async overlap.
2. Async overlap protocol:
   - For each batch N, the worker:
     a. Allocates the next-batch's CPU input scratch.
     b. Enqueues GPU stages for batch N on its owned HIP stream.
     c. Prepares batch N+1 on CPU **while batch N runs on GPU**.
     d. Waits on batch N's stream completion before reducing
        per-worker counters.
3. Stage routing decisions derived from the pipeline's stage list by
   `execution_class()` (amended 2026-06-10, see AMENDMENT):
   - The scheduler inspects `pipeline.stages()` and matches the
     landed `ExecutionClass::{CpuOnly, GpuOnly, Hybrid}` variants:
     `GpuOnly` stages are discovered FROM the pipeline (placed by
     `with_gpu(true)` with their CPU fallbacks registered) and
     enqueued on the worker's owned HIP stream; an all-`CpuOnly`
     stage list dispatches to the byte-identity-pinned SSOT CPU path
     (`run_snr_point`) as the `CpuOnly` routing outcome; the
     `Hybrid` arm is a documented seam (no Hybrid-class stage exists
     in the codebase).
   - Per-stage-driven execution of every stage via `AnyStage`
     (including the `Hybrid` split-per-batch behaviour) is OWNED BY
     `de160fc5` (moved there with `[hard]` rigor, 2026-06-10).
4. Tracing instrumentation (amended 2026-06-10, see AMENDMENT):
   every scheduler dispatch unit (CPU-prep composite, GPU LDPC
   decode, CPU decode tail) emits a span capturing `(worker_idx,
   snr_idx, batch_id, stream_id, stage_name, wall_us)`, with
   `stream_id` equal to the stream actually used (F1 fix). Per-stage
   span granularity lands with the per-stage executor in `de160fc5`.
5. Parallelism-pays receipt entry per project plan §5 schema:
   combined CPU+GPU throughput vs CPU-only-24-thread baseline on the
   calibration chain. Receipt name:
   `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/hybrid-executor-receipts.md`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Tracing output shows GPU stream activity overlapping CPU
  stage activity within the same SNR point (no serial-only
  utilisation gaps); a smoke test asserts overlap > 50% via the
  span analysis.
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate: combined CPU+GPU throughput
  receipt records ≥ 1.5× CPU-only-24-thread baseline on the
  calibration chain (DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM at deep waterfall).
  Receipt under `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/hybrid-executor-receipts.md`
  with link to `parallelism-receipts.md`.
- [hard] Deterministic dispatch: `cargo test -p gf2-sim
  --features hip` run twice produces byte-identical
  `fer / frames / errors / mean_iters` on a fixed seed.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `parallelism-pays` gates green.

## Non-goals

- DAG topology AND per-stage-driven execution via `AnyStage` by
  `execution_class()` incl. the `Hybrid` split-per-batch arm and
  per-stage spans (owned by `de160fc5`; moved 2026-06-10 with
  `[hard]` rigor).
- Resume / checkpoint (owned by `571c11c4`).
- OOM auto-fallback / hard-fail policy (owned by `42eac5cc`).
- Multi-GPU dispatch (epic non-goal).
